entries.name: New Zealand Privacy Act 2020
entries.scope_test: Assess whether the operator is an agency handling personal information and identify collection, use, storage, disclosure, access, correction, breach and overseas-transfer duties.

entries.name: New Zealand Public Records Act 2005
entries.scope_test: Assess whether the organization or activity is within the Act's public office or local authority scope, including contracted functions and records obligations.

entries.name: New Zealand Copyright Act 1994
entries.scope_test: Assess rights in source materials, copying, adaptation, preservation, communication, licensing and any applicable exceptions before ingesting or publishing content.

entries.name: EU General Data Protection Regulation
entries.scope_test: Assess territorial and material scope, controller/processor roles, data-subject location, processing purpose and transfer context.

entries.name: EU Artificial Intelligence Act as amended
entries.scope_test: Assess provider/deployer role, placing on market or use in scope, system purpose, risk category, relevant transitional dates and current consolidated text including amendments.

entries.name: NIST Secure Software Development Framework v1.1
entries.scope_test: Map secure development practices to software lifecycle controls; identify contractual or policy adoption separately.

entries.name: W3C PROV-O
entries.scope_test: Use as an interoperable provenance model for entities, activities, agents and derivations; it is not legislation.

entries.name: PREMIS Data Dictionary v3.0
entries.scope_test: Map digital preservation objects, events, agents and rights; define local conformance profile.

entries.name: RFC 8493 BagIt File Packaging Format
entries.scope_test: Use for packaging payloads with tag files and manifests for transfer and fixity verification.

mandatory_disclaimer: This catalogue is a research and control-mapping index. It does not determine legal applicability or certify compliance. Obtain qualified legal/privacy review before relying on a determination.
